messages:
maya: Hey folks — thinking about doing an 'International Snack Swap + Micro‑Games' at Wed lunch (May 6) 12:30–1:30 in the kitchen. Quick poll: up for it? React 👍 for yes, 😕 for maybe, 👎 for no
jon: 👍 totally! I can bring snacks from my trip (Portuguese custard tarts?)
eileen: 😄 love this. I'd help run a quick 10‑min game (two truths & a lie) if that's cool
maya: Awesome. Who's in to bring snacks? Here's a tiny sign‑up sheet: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-snack-swap (add country & allergy notes)
sam: Added — bringing Japanese onigiri (will label for soy/fish)
nora: Maybe remote folks want to join — can we do a short zoom + photo table? @maya
maya: Good call. I'll set a Zoom link and a shared album. Remote folks: ship/DIY snack welcome (label please!)
jon: Budget check: how much should people spend? $10‑ish ok?
eileen: $10 sounds fair
maya: Cool. I'll put a note in the sheet about budget + labeling. Also planning micro‑games: quick word guesses, paper‑plane toss (indoor friendly) + trivia
sam: Paper‑plane toss -> indoor friendly? maybe foam plane option 😬
jon: We'll do the foam ones :) Also can we have a 'spice rating' column? people with kids might wanna avoid super‑hot
maya: Yep added spice rating / allergens / veg/vegan column
calendar-bot: event created: 'International Snack Swap + Micro‑Games' Wed May 6 12:30–1:30 — maya invited lunch-plans
nora: Yay! count me in for running trivia
maya: Thanks y'all. If you're bringing something that needs reheating, put that in the sheet so we can reserve microwave time
jon: 👍 See you Wed!
